'''Fatal Elegy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Esh-kha]] who imprisoned along with the rest of his [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[the Tomb]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] until the [[invasion of Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A high-ranking warrior who had earned a name of his own, Fatal Elegy was among the elite Esh-kha warriors who spearheaded an incursion into the [[Rakata machine caves]] in order to shut down the Rakata stasis generators, but was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fatal Elegy is one of the five targets of "Esh-kha Elite", the bonus mission accompanying the Republic Heroic mission "The Stasis Generator" on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
